<!-- Generated by site/scripts/generate_reference.py: edit that script, not this file. -->

Run any command with `--help` to see the same in your terminal. A flag beats an environment variable, which beats `honest_agent_config.yml`, which beats the default.

## Options for every command

These go before the command, like `honest-agent --env-file prod.env run`.

- **`--version`**: Show the version and exit.
- **`--env-file FILE`**: Load settings and API keys from this file instead of the .env found from the current directory (or its parents). Variables already set in your shell take precedence. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_ENV_FILE`)*
- **`--config-file FILE`**: Read settings and targets from this file instead of the honest_agent_config.yml found from the current directory (or its parents). *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_CONFIG_FILE`)*

## `debug`

Check a project's setup, like `dbt debug`: the config file and target, the variables they need, the evals, the MCP server and the results store. Calls no model and runs no query: it lists the server's tools without calling one. Exits non-zero if a check fails.

```bash
honest-agent debug [OPTIONS]
```

- **`-t, --target TEXT`**: Target (agent) from honest_agent_config.yml to check. Defaults to its default_target.
- **`--evals-dir DIRECTORY`**: Directory of eval YAML files. Defaults to the target's evals_dir, else ./evals.
- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--model TEXT`**: Model to evaluate (the agent under test): a Claude model, or an OpenAI one (gpt-*, o3, o4-mini, ...). Only the API key for its provider is needed. Defaults to claude-haiku-5-5 if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else gpt-5.4-mini if OPENAI_API_KEY is set. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_MODEL`)*
- **`--grading-model TEXT`**: Model for grading: it pulls the value out of the answer for extract_match evals and judges the answer for llm_judge ones (contains needs none). Defaults to --model. Keeping it the same across runs keeps comparisons between agent models fair. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_GRADING_MODEL`)*
- **`--mcp-command TEXT`**: Shell command launching a local MCP server over stdio, e.g. "python mcp_server/server.py". Mutually exclusive with --mcp-url; when given on the command line, it overrides an MCP_URL set in the environment. *(environment variable `MCP_COMMAND`)*
- **`--mcp-url TEXT`**: URL of a remote MCP server's streamable-HTTP endpoint. Mutually exclusive with --mcp-command; when given on the command line, it overrides an MCP_COMMAND set in the environment. *(environment variable `MCP_URL`)*
- **`--mcp-bearer-token TEXT`**: [--mcp-url only] Bearer token sent as the Authorization header. *(environment variable `MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`)*
- **`--mcp-env NAME`**: [--mcp-command only] Environment variable the local MCP server needs, e.g. MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN. Repeat for several. The server gets only these plus a minimal environment (PATH, HOME, ...), never the rest of .env. Defaults to the target's mcp_env.

## `init`

Write a new project's starter files: config, a first eval and .env.

```bash
honest-agent init [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--server [snowflake|motherduck|url|local]`**: The MCP server your agent uses.
- **`--mcp-command TEXT`**: The command that starts a local MCP server (--server local).
- **`--mcp-url TEXT`**: The MCP server's URL (any other --server); it goes into .env.
- **`--target-name TEXT`**: The target's name. Defaults to the server's name.
- **`--model-provider [anthropic|openai]`**: anthropic (Claude) or openai.
- **`--results [local|motherduck|s3]`**: Where results live.
- **`--results-db TEXT`**: The MotherDuck database for results (--results motherduck).
- **`--no-input`**: Ask nothing: use the flags given and the defaults.
- **`--example`**: Instead, create honest-agent-example/: a demo agent over sample data with six evals.
- **`--with-skill`**: Add the setup skill for coding agents (asked otherwise). In a folder that already has honest_agent_config.yml, only adds it, or replaces it with this version's.

## `logs`

Print what each matching eval sent and received, call by call, as recorded: every model call, tool call and grading call with its request, response and timing. Scores and SQL summaries are in the report (`honest-agent report`).

```bash
honest-agent logs [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--run-id TEXT`**: Only show logs for this run.
- **`--eval-id TEXT`**: Only show logs for this eval id.
- **`--json`**: Print the raw records as JSON, exactly as stored.

## `ls`

List the evals a run would pick, with their id, category and tags, like `dbt ls`. Reads only the eval files: no model or MCP server.

```bash
honest-agent ls [OPTIONS]
```

- **`-t, --target TEXT`**: Target from honest_agent_config.yml whose evals to list.
- **`--evals-dir DIRECTORY`**: Directory of eval YAML files. Defaults to the target's evals_dir, else ./evals.
- **`-s, --select TEXT`**: Only these evals, dbt-`--select`-style: an eval id (e.g. top_segment), tag:&lt;tag> or category:&lt;category>. Spaces mean OR, commas mean AND: '--select "category:sales,tag:smoke top_segment"' picks the sales evals tagged smoke, plus top_segment. `honest-agent ls` lists ids, categories and tags.
- **`--exclude TEXT`**: Leave out these evals (same syntax as --select), after --select.

## `notify`

Send a Slack alert if the target's most recent run had any eval below its threshold.

```bash
honest-agent notify [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--target TEXT`**: Target (agent) from honest_agent_config.yml to alert on. Defaults to its default_target.
- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--webhook-url TEXT`**: The Slack incoming webhook to post the alert to. *(environment variable `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`)*
- **`--report-url TEXT`**: Where the report is published, so the alert links to each failing eval. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_REPORT_URL`)*

## `rebuild`

Re-derive results, SQL calls and traces from the raw record of past runs, after a change to how honest-agent scores or reads them. Calls no model: it costs nothing and uses each run's own settings and eval definitions. Runs recorded before honest-agent kept raw records, and evals stopped by an error, are left as they are.

```bash
honest-agent rebuild [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--run-id TEXT`**: Only rebuild this run.

## `report`

Write the report (web UI + recent results) to a folder.

```bash
honest-agent report [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--out DIRECTORY`**: Report folder (web UI + data/report.json). *(default `honest_agent_report`)*
- **`--days INTEGER RANGE`**: Include results from this many days before the latest run. Older results stay in the results file. *(default `30`)*

## `run`

Run every eval, grade the answers, and write results to storage. Exits 1 if any eval falls below its threshold, like a failing test.

```bash
honest-agent run [OPTIONS]
```

- **`-t, --target TEXT`**: Target (agent) from honest_agent_config.yml to evaluate. Defaults to its default_target.
- **`--evals-dir DIRECTORY`**: Directory of eval YAML files. Defaults to the target's evals_dir, else ./evals.
- **`--results-path TEXT`**: Local DuckDB file where results are stored (created on first `run`), or a MotherDuck database as md:&lt;name>, opened with HONEST_AGENT_RESULTS_TOKEN.
- **`--model TEXT`**: Model to evaluate (the agent under test): a Claude model, or an OpenAI one (gpt-*, o3, o4-mini, ...). Only the API key for its provider is needed. Defaults to claude-haiku-5-5 if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else gpt-5.4-mini if OPENAI_API_KEY is set. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_MODEL`)*
- **`--grading-model TEXT`**: Model for grading: it pulls the value out of the answer for extract_match evals and judges the answer for llm_judge ones (contains needs none). Defaults to --model. Keeping it the same across runs keeps comparisons between agent models fair. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_GRADING_MODEL`)*
- **`--max-tool-steps INTEGER RANGE`**: Max steps per eval before giving up: each step is one model API call and the tool calls it asks for. If the model still wants to call tools when this is hit, that eval fails with a clear error instead of silently returning an empty answer. *(default `5`)*
- **`--mcp-command TEXT`**: Shell command launching a local MCP server over stdio, e.g. "python mcp_server/server.py". Mutually exclusive with --mcp-url; when given on the command line, it overrides an MCP_URL set in the environment. *(environment variable `MCP_COMMAND`)*
- **`--mcp-url TEXT`**: URL of a remote MCP server's streamable-HTTP endpoint. Mutually exclusive with --mcp-command; when given on the command line, it overrides an MCP_COMMAND set in the environment. *(environment variable `MCP_URL`)*
- **`--mcp-bearer-token TEXT`**: [--mcp-url only] Bearer token sent as the Authorization header. *(environment variable `MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`)*
- **`--mcp-env NAME`**: [--mcp-command only] Environment variable the local MCP server needs, e.g. MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN. Repeat for several. The server gets only these plus a minimal environment (PATH, HOME, ...), never the rest of .env. Defaults to the target's mcp_env.
- **`--agent-name TEXT`**: Label for the agent being evaluated (e.g. snowflake, motherduck), stored with every result so reports can filter by agent. Defaults to the target's agent_name or name, else the name the MCP server reports about itself. *(environment variable `HONEST_AGENT_AGENT_NAME`)*
- **`-s, --select TEXT`**: Only these evals, dbt-`--select`-style: an eval id (e.g. top_segment), tag:&lt;tag> or category:&lt;category>. Spaces mean OR, commas mean AND: '--select "category:sales,tag:smoke top_segment"' picks the sales evals tagged smoke, plus top_segment. `honest-agent ls` lists ids, categories and tags.
- **`--exclude TEXT`**: Leave out these evals (same syntax as --select), after --select.

## `serve`

Serve a generated report folder locally, the same way `dbt docs serve` does.

```bash
honest-agent serve [OPTIONS]
```

- **`--out DIRECTORY`**: Report folder (web UI + data/report.json). *(default `honest_agent_report`)*
- **`--port INTEGER`**: Port to serve the report on, at http://127.0.0.1:&lt;port>/. *(default `8000`)*
- **`--open-browser / --no-open-browser`**: Open the report in your browser. *(default `--open-browser`)*
